SELECT
    s.School,
    s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS FullStreetAddress
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > ( SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' )

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sa.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT schools.Website, schools.School
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT DISTINCT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`High Grade` = '12'

SELECT s.City
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT "School Name",
       "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Eligible Free Rate"
FROM frpm
WHERE "Educational Option Type" = 'Continuation School'
  AND "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(School) AS active_schools
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND County = 'San Joaquin'
  AND StatusType = 'Active'

SELECT School, Phone, Ext
FROM schools
WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'

SELECT schools.School, satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE (schools.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR schools.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')

SELECT `Low Grade`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
  AND CAST(s.NCESDist AS INTEGER) = 613360

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY Longitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND schools.City = 'Fremont'
  AND frpm.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT T2.AdmFName1, T2.AdmLName1
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.City AS City,
    a.AdmFName1 || ' ' || a.AdmLName1 AS AdministratorName
FROM 
    schools s
LEFT JOIN 
    schools a ON s.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.Charter = 1
    AND s.CharterNum = '00D2'
    AND a.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    AND a.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.City AS City,
    a.AdmFName2 || ' ' || a.AdmLName2 AS AdministratorName
FROM 
    schools s
LEFT JOIN 
    schools a ON s.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.Charter = 1
    AND s.CharterNum = '00D2'
    AND a.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    AND a.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.City AS City,
    a.AdmFName3 || ' ' || a.AdmLName3 AS AdministratorName
FROM 
    schools s
LEFT JOIN 
    schools a ON s.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.Charter = 1
    AND s.CharterNum = '00D2'
    AND a.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
    AND a.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
ORDER BY County, ClosedDate
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(FundingType) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Santa Clara'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Active, SUM(CASE WHEN StatusType = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Closed FROM schools WHERE SOCType = 'District Community Day Schools' AND County = 'Alpine'

SELECT `frpm`.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, `frpm`.`District Code`
FROM `schools`
JOIN `frpm` ON `schools`.`CDSCode` = `frpm`.`CDSCode`
WHERE `schools`.`AdmFName1` = 'Alusine'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03'
SELECT T1.AdmFName1, T1.District FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode GROUP BY T1.AdmFName1 ORDER BY COUNT(T1.AdmFName1) DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp AS d
JOIN account AS a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT t.amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'
ORDER BY t.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date >= '1993-01-01'
  AND a.date < '1994-01-01'
  AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
    FROM loan l2
    JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
    WHERE l2.duration > 12
      AND a2.date >= '1993-01-01'
      AND a2.date < '1994-01-01'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT COUNT(c.card_id)
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'classic'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT d.A2 AS district, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541

SELECT T3.A2, (T3.A13 - T3.A12) / T3.A12 * 100 FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.status = 'D'

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

SELECT CAST(
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS REAL
) * 100 / COUNT(card_id) AS percent
FROM card

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.A3 = 'south Bohemia' AND T2.account_id NOT IN ( SELECT T3.account_id FROM disp AS T3 INNER JOIN card AS T4 ON T3.disp_id = T4.disp_id )

SELECT trans.*
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.district_id = 5

SELECT COUNT(disp_id)
FROM disp
WHERE type IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT')
  AND account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10

SELECT client.client_id
FROM client
INNER JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.birth_date BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.date LIKE '1998%' AND T2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' GROUP BY T1.account_id HAVING SUM(T2.amount) < ( SELECT AVG(T3.amount) FROM trans AS T3 WHERE T3.date LIKE '1998%' AND T3.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' )

SELECT d.A2
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(a.account_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT client_id
FROM disp
WHERE account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM `order`
    WHERE order_id = 32423
)

SELECT 
    (sum_1997 - sum_1996) * 100.0 / sum_1996 AS growth_rate
FROM
    (SELECT SUM(loan.amount) AS sum_1996
     FROM loan
     JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
     JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
     WHERE client.gender = 'M'
       AND strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1996'
    ) AS y1996,
    (SELECT SUM(loan.amount) AS sum_1997
     FROM loan
     JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
     JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
     WHERE client.gender = 'M'
       AND strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1997'
    ) AS y1997

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) AS REAL) 
       * 100 
       / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_male
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'

SELECT SUM(l.amount) AS debt_amount, l.status
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 992
GROUP BY l.status

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'USER'

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND t.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND t.amount > 4000

SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE element = 'si'

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'o' AND m.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT b.molecule_id
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS average_single_bonded_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT client.client_id, client.district_id
FROM client
INNER JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '='

SELECT atom_id, atom_id2
FROM connected
WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'

SELECT 
    (SELECT bond_type 
     FROM bond 
     WHERE molecule_id = 'TR018' 
     GROUP BY bond_type 
     ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS most_common_bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR018') = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR181'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
WHERE atom.element IN ('i', 's')
  AND atom.molecule_id IN (
      SELECT bond.molecule_id
      FROM bond
      WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  )

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12')

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(
        CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM atom a
            WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
              AND a.element = 'f'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id)) AS percent
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR000_2_5'

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR050'

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM connected
)

SELECT a.molecule_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenicity
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'

SELECT 
    a.element AS element1,
    b.element AS element2,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom b ON c.atom_id2 = b.atom_id
GROUP BY a.element, b.element
ORDER BY bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-')

SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.element) AS hydrogen_ratio,
       m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label

SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11'

SELECT SUM(element = 'cl') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'ca'
)
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM connected AS c
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
    AND (
         (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
      OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl')
    )
) AS has_cl_and_c

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS tally
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'i' OR a2.element = 'i'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_with_double_bond,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = '='

SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2, a1.element AS atom1_element, a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN m.molecule_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id), 0) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE cardKingdomFoilId = cardKingdomId
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE faceConvertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(faceConvertedManaCost)
    FROM cards
)

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion = '2015'
  AND edhrecRank < 100

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 's'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '='
)

SELECT cards.name
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE cards.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND legalities.format = 'gladiator'
  AND legalities.status = 'Banned'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#'
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = '='

SELECT cards.name, cards.artist, cards.isPromo
FROM cards
JOIN rulings ON cards.uuid = rulings.uuid
GROUP BY cards.uuid, cards.name, cards.artist, cards.isPromo
ORDER BY COUNT(rulings.uuid) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT originalType
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

SELECT promoTypes
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Duress'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR024'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND a.molecule_id = 'TR024'

SELECT name, colors
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'OGW'

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON (a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2)
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = '='

SELECT c.name AS card_name,
       r.text AS ruling_text,
       c.hasContentWarning AS missing_or_degraded_properties
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'

SELECT cards.name, rulings.date
FROM cards
JOIN rulings ON cards.uuid = rulings.uuid
WHERE cards.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'borderless'
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT st.language
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM foreign_data

SELECT c.name
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.uuid IN (
    SELECT f.uuid
    FROM foreign_data AS f
    WHERE f.language = 'Japanese'
)

FROM cards c

SELECT
    CAST(
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
    AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END),
        0
    )
FROM yearmonth AS y
WHERE y.CustomerID = (
    SELECT t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
      AND t.Price = 634.8
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
